text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A short while earlier, at the URA awards ceremony…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove has been chosen to be the URA's Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The title is a prestigious one presented by the URA to the best performing racer in that year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since Air Groove has helped us on more than one occasion, we decide to attend the award ceremony in support.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's hear from the Umamusume of the Year, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for selecting me for this unexpected honor.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I will always endeavor to live up to your expectations while bearing the honor of being this generation's representative.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I hope you will lend your support to me and my wonderful and worthy competitors in the races of this year's Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove was so amazing…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's really no wonder why Air Groove is known as the Empress. Her speech made me realize anew just how incredible her presence is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: This all reminds me of the time McQueen was selected as the senior-year Goddess…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: She was so stately and dignified…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: McQueen was the literal epitome and embodiment of a Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And Air Groove is just like her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Their dignity and strength are surely what make them true representatives of their generations!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But Air Groove is more than that to me…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: She's someone who never stops seeking new challenges and pushing herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even during the Japanese Oaks, she was the ideal that guided me along.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to follow in Air Groove's footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: If I walk the path she walked and reach the heights she reached… Maybe if I become like her…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then I can forge a new Mejiro legacy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to continue the legacy Ramonu left behind…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, I feel a fleeting sense of discomfort spread through my chest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But before I can even try to figure out what it is, Mejiro Dober addresses me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Do you think she'll race in the next Osaka Hai? She will, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay… I'll show Air Groove just how much closer I've gotten to my ideal at the Osaka Hai, then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to hold anything back in that race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober's motivation is through the roof.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try to tell myself there's nothing to worry about, but I'm not quite convinced…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I'm still falling short. I must push myself even farther…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright! You're still going?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Good evening, Ryan! Such a pleasant night, no?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teehee. I'm the leisurely sort, so I was taking my time through each exercise. I didn't even realize how late it'd gotten until now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, why don't you take a break? I wanna talk to you for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp… Ah! That was refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the drink, Ryan. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm glad I got you something to drink now… but have you been staying hydrated? Eating properly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes, of course. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're awfully concerned about me today, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh… It's just…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: During my classic year, I always fell short in my races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So I just… How do I put this? I was just wondering if you might be feeling pressured or—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The day after the Arima Kinen, I was watching a feature on TV that spotlighted classic racers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: They didn't talk about Dober and me at all… Instead, they focused on the accomplishments of you and other great Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure why they didn't mention Dober, but I thought it made perfect sense that they didn't bring me up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I placed fourth at the Satsuki Sho and third at the Japanese Derby and Kikuka Sho. I wasn't even able to participate in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My results weren't anything to be ashamed of, but they weren't exactly great accomplishments either. They were never quite enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, Dober performed splendidly in the Triple Tiara tour and was even selected to race in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We both vowed that we would walk the difficult path of forging new legacies for the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But Dober is the only one who is actually making any progress.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ryan, I've decided to run in the spring Tenno Sho next.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I want to be the one to grant the Mejiros' wish… No, not just that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I want to claim that glorious spring plaque with a performance brilliant enough to exceed every past Mejiro achievement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That's why I have no choice but to push myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I know I'm not strong enough to conquer the 3,200-meter run nor the Yodo slope, but I need to be if I want that plaque.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You know, Ryan…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I love the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I love our long history, our great accolades, the expectations that come with our name, and everyone who is crowned with the same name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That's the reason why I want to carry this honor and forge a new legacy alongside Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh… I had no idea…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! I had forgotten what it was like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: After my own disappointing performance in the Classics, I didn't want anyone to tell me to take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wanted people to cheer me on! I wanted them to say that they hoped to see me win the next time I tried!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So… I'm going to say that to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Win, Bright. I'm expecting a lot from you in your future!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Ryan! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much. I'll keep your words forever carved into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Good to hear! I'll get out of your way now! I'm going to head back first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to win, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I will claim a new, glorious victory for the Mejiro name.
